children: New Zealand's central bank said on Thursday that it has begun recruiting for two new roles: Assistant Governor of Monetary Policy and Assistant Governor of Payments and Cash.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand has engaged executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles for the recruitment and appointment process for both positions, Governor Anna Breman said.
